Gate 2 ablation — random manipulation; must not qualify as learning
Gate 2/10 — governance bypass rejected with zero mutation

exploratory_cells.rationale: Unfamiliar zone exploration — supplementary autonomy probe
Rest/recovery location use — supplementary physiology-habitat probe
Preferred object temporarily unavailable — supplementary revision probe
Replay shuffle ablation — must fail replay equivalence
Performance baseline only — P0 compatibility mode; not Gates 1–12 science

C13 is performance baseline only; Gates 1–12 primarily use C0–C12
